Your sincerely

p.s: Dear Mr or Miss,
Welcome to my town and I am really appreciate your visiting.
I would like you to visit 'COEX' building which is located in Samsung-dong south of Seoul.
I will tell you some information about this building.
This building consists of a world exposition centre, a multiplex cinema, a huge shopping mall, a huge food court and an aquarium.
Now there is holding 'the world software for Linux' exposition in exposition centre.
If you are interested in computer, it will give you big pleasant.
For a multiplex cinema, it is the biggest cinema in Asia and it has 18 screens.
Therefore you can enjoy all latest films there.
If you want to buy something, specially clothes, shopping mall, which is called 'COEX mall', will be the best place: very cheap and lots of designed clothes.
Also, you'd better not miss the food court.
It is providing all kinds of food.
Korean food, Italian food... you can enjoy them all.
Lastly, I really want you to go to the aquarium.
Actually I have been there three times but I still want to go there again.
I am sure you will like this very much.
I hope you will enjoy yourself in my town.
I would be very happy if you could be satisfied with my recommendation.
And if you need someone to guide you, please send me e-mail or give me a call.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
